class.name: NetwGroupPromise
class.brief_description: The results of a request sent to many peers, one per peer.
class.description: [method Netw.request_all] returns one. It waits for the peers connected when the request was sent. A peer that disconnects is no longer waited for. [method then] runs once with every result, as a [code]peer_id -> value[/code] [Dictionary]. [signal completed_single] reports each result as it arrives. [codeblock] Netw.request_all(player.ready_check) \ .then(func(votes: Dictionary) -> void: start_when_all_ready(votes) ) [/codeblock] On timeout, [method catch_error] runs with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_TIMEOUT], and the results that did arrive stay in [member results]. It works like [NetwPromise] otherwise.

method.name: answer
method.description: Returns [member results] on success, or [member code] on failure.

method.name: catch_error
method.description: Calls [param cb] as [code]cb(code, detail)[/code] when the group fails. Returns the group.

method.name: create
method.description: Creates a group waiting for [param peers]. An empty group does not complete by itself, so call [method resolve_all] once callbacks are attached.

method.name: reject
method.description: Fails the group and emits [signal failed], then [signal settled]. Does nothing when already settled.

method.name: remove_peer
method.description: Stops waiting for [param peer_id], as when it disconnects. Completes the group if it was the last one.

method.name: resolve_all
method.description: Completes the group with the current [member results], and emits [signal completed], then [signal settled].

method.name: resolve_peer
method.description: Records the result of [param peer_id] and emits [signal completed_single]. Completes the group if it was the last one. Ignored for a peer the group is not waiting for.

method.name: then
method.description: Calls [param cb] with [member results] when every peer answered. Returns the group.

method.name: wait
method.description: Returns a signal to [code]await[/code], which gives [method answer]. It works even when the group already settled. [codeblock] await destination.move_players(peers).wait() [/codeblock]

members.member: A readable reason for [member code], or empty. For display only.
The peers that have not answered yet.
[code]true[/code] when the group completed or failed.
The results received so far, as [code]peer_id -> value[/code].

signal.name: failed
signal.description: Emitted when the group fails or times out.

signal.name: ready
signal.description: Used by [method wait]. Connect to [signal settled] instead, since this can be emitted more than once.

signal.name: settled
signal.description: Emitted once after [signal completed] or [signal failed].
